title: Santa's Workshop 15" Holly Jolly Claus

comparisons.notes: Santa's Workshop 15 Inch Holly Jolly Claus, model 6046, red resin, same 'Have a Holly Jolly Christmas' tree sign; sale price with free standard shipping, no out-of-stock notice.
Holly Jolly 15" Santa, SKU 162821, same official description as Santa's Workshop 6046; product image named 6046.jpg; available=true, ships in about 6 days.

writeup: Santa's Workshop's 15-inch Holly Jolly Claus (model 6046) is a hand-painted resin mantel Santa carrying a toy sack and a little tree with a "Have a Holly Jolly Christmas" sign. Woot has it new for $26.99, while Bed Bath & Beyond sells the same model for $55.43 and Art Brand Studios for $56, so you save about half. Quantity is limited to 3 per customer.
